text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to build up our 
strength begins today. As for Yukino 
Bijin—
choice_data_list: That's quite a lot of luggage.
That's quite a lot of luggage.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I figured this summer was the real 
showdown! So I prepared all sorts of 
things!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the village sent me so much 
stuff, too. Like delicious water from 
Morioka, sun hats... and watermelons!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! Plus, we can stay hydrated too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I look forward to working with you 
starting today!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like if I run my best at the Shuka 
Sho, everything will turn around for the 
better."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Because Umamusume who run are just so 
damn cool."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So... if I can pull off a dazzling run, 
everyone's bound to see me in a new light!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's gonna put her whole heart 
into it and do her best!
choice_data_list: Let's grow a lot this summer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've gotta win the Queen Stakes too, no 
matter what...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a scorching summer with Yukino 
Bijin began.
